document.summary: `runDeterministicChecks` puts wording issues on `lints`, and `caseFailed` reads only `failures`. `comprehende-67` allows three parts, and `comprehende-47` no longer scores part count.

Report lint N from DeterministicReport.lints. Do not put proseLint in failures, so caseFailed and process exit stay green on wording length alone.
